title: Ice Cave
statementMd:
You play a computer game. Your character stands on some level of a multilevel ice cave. In order to move on forward, you need to descend one level lower and the only way to do this is to fall through the ice.

The level of the cave where you are is a rectangular square grid of $*n*$ rows and $*m*$ columns. Each cell consists either from intact or from cracked ice. From each cell you can move to cells that are side-adjacent with yours (due to some limitations of the game engine you cannot make jumps on the same place, i.e. jump from a cell to itself). If you move to the cell with cracked ice, then your character falls down through it and if you move to the cell with intact ice, then the ice on this cell becomes cracked.

Let's number the rows with integers from $1$ to $*n*$ from top to bottom and the columns with integers from $1$ to $*m*$ from left to right. Let's denote a cell on the intersection of the $*r*$-th row and the $*c*$-th column as $(*r*, *c*)$.

You are staying in the cell $(*r*_{1}, *c*_{1})$ and this cell is cracked because you've just fallen here from a higher level. You need to fall down through the cell $(*r*_{2}, *c*_{2})$ since the exit to the next level is there. Can you do this?

## Input

The first line contains two integers, $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 500$) — the number of rows and columns in the cave description.

Each of the next $*n*$ lines describes the initial state of the level of the cave, each line consists of $*m*$ characters "`.`" (that is, intact ice) and "`X`" (cracked ice).

The next line contains two integers, $*r*_{1}$ and $*c*_{1}$ ($1 ≤ *r*_{1} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *c*_{1} ≤ *m*$) — your initial coordinates. It is guaranteed that the description of the cave contains character '`X`' in cell $(*r*_{1}, *c*_{1})$, that is, the ice on the starting cell is initially cracked.

The next line contains two integers $*r*_{2}$ and $*c*_{2}$ ($1 ≤ *r*_{2} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *c*_{2} ≤ *m*$) — the coordinates of the cell through which you need to fall. The final cell may coincide with the starting one.

## Output

If you can reach the destination, print '`YES`', otherwise print '`NO`'.

## Note

In the first sample test one possible path is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c61f56de718beea14935ccdc85ae2c4ad45c1454.png)

After the first visit of cell $(2, 2)$ the ice on it cracks and when you step there for the second time, your character falls through the ice as intended.
statementZhMd:
你正在玩一个电脑游戏。你的角色站在多层冰洞的某一层。为了继续前进，你需要下降到更低的一层，而唯一的方法就是穿过冰层掉下去。

你所在的冰洞楼层是一个由 $*n*$ 行、$*m*$ 列组成的矩形方格网。每个格子中的冰要么是完整的，要么是破裂的。你可以从每个格子移动到与它共享边的格子（由于游戏引擎的限制，你不能原地跳跃，即不能从一个格子跳到它自身）。如果你移动到一个冰层已经破裂的格子，你的角色就会从那里掉下去；如果你移动到一个冰层完整的格子，该格子的冰层就会变为破裂状态。

我们将行从上到下编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$，将列从左到右编号为 $1$ 到 $*m*$。第 $*r*$ 行与第 $*c*$ 列交汇处的格子记为 $(*r*, *c*)$。

你现在位于格子 $(*r*_{1}, *c*_{1})$，由于你刚从更高的一层掉下来，该格子的冰层已经破裂。你需要从格子 $(*r*_{2}, *c*_{2})$ 穿过冰层掉下去，因为通往下一层的出口就在这里。你能做到吗？

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 500$）——冰洞描述中的行数和列数。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行描述冰洞这一层的初始状态，每行包含 $*m*$ 个字符“`.`”（表示完整的冰层）和“`X`”（表示破裂的冰层）。

下一行包含两个整数 $*r*_{1}$ 和 $*c*_{1}$（$1 ≤ *r*_{1} ≤ *n*$，$1 ≤ *c*_{1} ≤ *m*$）——你的初始坐标。保证冰洞描述中格子 $(*r*_{1}, *c*_{1})$ 包含字符 '`X`'，也就是说，起始格子的冰层初始时已经破裂。

下一行包含两个整数 $*r*_{2}$ 和 $*c*_{2}$（$1 ≤ *r*_{2} ≤ *n*$，$1 ≤ *c*_{2} ≤ *m*$）——你需要从中穿过冰层掉下去的格子的坐标。终点格子可能与起点格子重合。

## 输出格式

如果你能够到达终点，输出 '`YES`'；否则输出 '`NO`'。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，一条可行路径如下：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c61f56de718beea14935ccdc85ae2c4ad45c1454.png)

第一次经过格子 $(2, 2)$ 后，该格子的冰层会破裂；当你第二次走到那里时，你的角色就会按照预期穿过冰层掉下去。
